headline: Site plan and special permit for 179 apartments at 37 Enon Street, plus traffic and pedestrian safety reviews.
summary: The agenda includes a recommendation to the Planning Board on a 179-apartment project at 37 Enon Street. It also covers traffic and pedestrian safety reviews and a request to review Essex Street and Cole Street.
items: Public comment period, up to 15 minutes

Recommendation to Planning Board on Site Plan Review SPR 26-42 and Special Permit SP-26-5 for 37 Enon Street: 179 residential apartments, about 2,600 sf of retail space, and 281 parking spaces where 367 are required; special permit to allow 1.5 parking spaces per residential unit (continued from previous meeting)

Traffic and pedestrian safety concerns and possible recommendations at the intersection of Peabody Avenue, Larcom Avenue and Sargent Avenue, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor (continued from previous meeting)
Pedestrian safety concerns and possible recommendation at the intersection of Hale Street and Corning Street, submitted by Scott Houseman, Ward 4 City Councilor

Recommendation to City Council on Order #258-2026, requesting Parking & Traffic Commission review along Essex Street and Cole Street, submitted by Matthew St. Hilaire, Councilor-at-Large; to be continued over multiple meetings, with this meeting focusing on prioritizing the eight areas requested, time permitting
Construction or project update for 119 Rantoul Street, Wendell Holmes LLC (owner): no update, currently under construction
location: 1st Floor Conference Room, Temporary Beverly City Hall, 195 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA
